### 59cada58019373ad7ffb23ef9ab5494f3d461da0

[59cada58019373ad7ffb23ef9ab5494f3d461da0](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/59cada58019373ad7ffb23ef9ab5494f3d461da0)

Date: 2026-10-29T13:28:39-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Inventory & Loot, Networking & Sessions, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(presentation): drain render event queues without subscribers
```

#### Original body

```text
Render drains used `Event?.Invoke(queue.Dequeue())`. With no
subscriber, the null-conditional call skips evaluating its argument,
so the item was never dequeued. A `while` drain then spun forever on
the main thread and froze the Unity Editor. A pickup grant received
by a local Input Authority without a bound loot HUD reproduced it
(UtilityExpeditionPlayModeTests.UtilityCooldown_PersistsAcrossDropAndPickup).

Dequeue into a local before invoking in every affected drain:
- PlayerLootReceiver (LootGranted)
- PlayerWeaponEquipmentNetworkController (EquipRequestResolved)
- PlayerCombatNetworkController (CombatFeedbackResolved)
- TownPartyDirectory (InvitationResultReceived)
- PlayerInteractionNetworkController (InteractionResolved): its bounded
  loop did not hang but left events queued for later subscribers

Tests:
- NetworkLootPickupPartialPickupPlayModeTests.
  PickupGrant_WithoutPresentationSubscriber_DrainsOnRender

Validation: the previously hanging test passes; pickup fixture 6/6 and
PlayerCombatNetworkController 14/14 pass. Remaining failures in the
UtilityExpedition, PlayerEquipment, PlayerDownedReviveInteraction and
TownPartyLocalAuthority fixtures reproduce identically without this
change.
```

### 2e026eabf23d52e7be527718f9f37cb9c8d59152

[2e026eabf23d52e7be527718f9f37cb9c8d59152](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/2e026eabf23d52e7be527718f9f37cb9c8d59152)

Date: 2026-10-29T12:53:45-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Inventory & Loot, World & Visibility, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(loot): collect world pickups partially when capacity runs out
```

#### Original body

```text
A pickup that does not fully fit the player's Inventory now transfers
the largest admissible quantity instead of rejecting the interaction.
The remainder stays in the same pickup with its exact Raid origins and
first-acquisition eligibility, and remains available to any player.
Zero admissible units still reject without changing the pickup, and a
complete transfer still despawns it (Doc 07 sections 11, 14 and 28).

Only capacity failures (InventoryFull, MaxTransportableExceeded,
Overflow) enter the partial path. The admissible amount is the largest
canonical, Dungeon-first prefix of the pickup's origins accepted by
both side-effect-free receiver validators, found by binary search. The
remainder's origin state is encoded before the receiver commit.
Eligibility is consumed eligible-first, and Progress, treasure
instability and pickup feedback use only the collected units. A
partial success returns Succeeded(isConsumed: false).

Add RaidLootOriginTransfer.TrySplit for exact canonical splits.

Tests:
- RaidLootOriginTransferSplitTests (EditMode, 7 cases)
- NetworkLootPickupPartialPickupPlayModeTests (PlayMode, 5 cases):
  full, partial, zero capacity, mixed-origin remainder and sequential
  competitors

Docs: LootInteractionArchitecture pickup reception section.

Validation: new fixtures pass; PlayerLootReceiverSlots 24/24 and
RaidInventoryPresenterInteraction 56/56 PlayMode pass. Pre-existing
failures are unchanged. Host/Client replication is not yet validated.

Refs: TASK-228
Player-Improved: Picking up a stack you can only partly carry now takes what fits and leaves the rest on the ground.
```

### 83f64225817dfdfcc36b08c818945a289f1971d2

[83f64225817dfdfcc36b08c818945a289f1971d2](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/83f64225817dfdfcc36b08c818945a289f1971d2)

Date: 2026-10-29T11:02:40-03:00 · Classification: Refactoring (explicit) · Systems: UI, World & Visibility, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
refactor(minimap): resolve the minimap layout from the loaded Raid scene
```

#### Original body

```text
The HUD minimap was bound to Gameplay.unity through a single layout baked
into the HUD prefab, so any other Raid map showed the wrong minimap.

Each Raid scene now declares its own map with one RaidSceneMinimap that
references its generated MinimapLayout and its Floor/Walls/Obstacles
Tilemap root. RaidMinimapPresenter resolves it once per bind and fails
with a clear error instead of falling back to another map. The graphic
keeps the bound layout out of the serialized preview field so prefab
assets are never mutated.

MinimapLayoutGenerator now finds every scene that declares a
RaidSceneMinimap and generates one layout per scene with a per-scene
dependency hash. Gameplay.unity declares its existing layout.
```

### 41f48d4a61d1874a59eadb6808f32d536e516848

[41f48d4a61d1874a59eadb6808f32d536e516848](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/41f48d4a61d1874a59eadb6808f32d536e516848)

Date: 2026-10-28T18:32:32-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Abilities, Build & Tooling, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(combat): enforce friendly fire and ally 1 HP floor
```

#### Original body

```text
Apply the Doc 19 section 7 Friendly Fire rules in the authoritative
damage pipeline. Allies are players on the same initial Raid team
(AbilityAllyAffiliation, fail closed); environmental and creature
damage are never ally damage.

- Friendly Fire off: DamageResolver rejects ally hits with
  FriendlyFireBlocked before the target mutates; no damage, knockback,
  aggro or contribution.
- Friendly Fire on: ally damage is scaled by the serialized
  _allyDamageMultiplier (default 1.0) and the resolver rebuilds the
  request with DamageRequest.IsAllyDirectDamage, which callers cannot
  set themselves.
- CharacterBase clamps ally damage after mitigation so Health never
  drops below 1 HP and never runs the fatal/Downed interception.
- PlayerCharacter ignores ally hits on the Downed Health reserve and
  never calls NotifyDownedDamaged, so revive is not interrupted.
- Eligible knockback still applies to an allowed ally hit whose clamped
  damage is 0. Aggro and contribution need applied damage > 0.
- AbilityImpact routes zero-damage pushes through the resolver, and
  NetworkExplosiveBomb drops its direct ApplyDamage fallback, so no
  path bypasses the policy.
- Pure decision math lives in FriendlyFireRules.

Tests:
- FriendlyFireRulesTests: blocking, multiplier, post-mitigation floor,
  non-ally and environmental damage.
- DamageResolverFriendlyFireTests: blocked ally hit, unavailable
  policy, non-ally/environmental damage, zero-damage push knockback.
- PlayerDownedPlayModeTests: multiplier and repeated ally hits stop at
  1 HP without Downed.
- PlayerDownedRecoveryPlayModeTests: ally hits keep the Downed reserve
  and assisted revive; zero-effective reviver hits do not interrupt.

Refs: TASK-245
Player-Added: Teammates can no longer hurt, push or down each other in a raid unless the host enables friendly fire, and even then they can never knock an ally down.
```

### 845668987ed4a4e53da0901d5358416377c98d7f

[845668987ed4a4e53da0901d5358416377c98d7f](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/845668987ed4a4e53da0901d5358416377c98d7f)

Date: 2026-10-28T16:59:24-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Abilities, Movement, Inventory & Loot, Build & Tooling, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(combat): resolve knockback with resistance and strict replacement
```

#### Original body

```text
Replace the additive, friction-decayed knockback velocity with the
authoritative Doc 18 section 6 model on players and enemies. A push is
mitigated by Knockback Resistance (RE), at most one push is active per
character, and eligibility is taken from the state at impact.

- IKnockbackReceiver/IKnockbackMotor now carry a KnockbackRequest
  (direction, original PE, eligibility snapshot) and return a
  KnockbackDecision. CharacterBase applies max(0, PE - RE).
- DamageResolver snapshots IsKnockbackEligible before ApplyDamage, so a
  hit that downs an Active player still pushes; hits on an already
  Downed player never start or replace a push. Defeat cancels travel.
- Player and enemy motors keep one networked push (direction, effective
  PE, distance, start tick, duration) written by State Authority. Steps
  derive from the curve and tick, so resimulation is safe and blocked
  distance against walls is lost. Absorbed pushes do not interrupt
  abilities or bump KnockbackSequence. Restore spawns keep the state in
  Fusion's resumed tick domain; fresh spawns reset it.
- RE comes from armor (ArmorDefinition.KnockbackResistance, aggregated in
  EquipmentStatisticsModifiers, no attribute scaling) and from a
  serialized enemy value (default 0).
- Existing KnockbackForce fields are reinterpreted as original PE; no
  serialized field was renamed.
- Add KnockbackCurveConfig.asset and reference it from NetworkPlayer,
  SocialPlayer and NetworkEnemy (enemy variants inherit it). A missing
  or invalid config fails dependency validation with an error.

Tests:
- EquipmentStatisticsCalculatorTests: RE accumulates across armor and
  RE-only armor validates.
- Ability PlayMode tests migrated to TryApplyKnockback and the new
  active-push accessors.

Refs: TASK-244
Player-Improved: Knockbacks no longer stack: only a stronger hit replaces an ongoing push, armor can resist pushes, and players already downed are no longer pushed around.
```

### ca8046999f7ca636bfb13a23eee2fef608498f78

[ca8046999f7ca636bfb13a23eee2fef608498f78](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/ca8046999f7ca636bfb13a23eee2fef608498f78)

Date: 2026-10-28T16:58:32-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Build & Tooling, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(combat): add knockback power rules and curve config
```

#### Original body

```text
Add the pure, allocation-free rules for Doc 18 section 6 knockback and
the ScriptableObject that converts effective push power into travel.
Nothing consumes them yet; motor integration follows separately.

- KnockbackRules: effective PE = max(0, PE - RE), strict replacement
  decision (only a strictly greater effective PE replaces the active
  push; ties keep it), eligibility snapshot at impact, continuation
  through Downed and cancellation on definitive Defeat, cumulative
  per-tick step and completion.
- KnockbackCurveConfig: effective PE to distance (0.1 m/PE, max 3 m),
  duration (0.03 s/PE clamped to [0.1, 0.5] s, ceil to ticks with a
  float tolerance) and an ease-out cumulative profile. Values are
  placeholders pending balance (Doc 18 section 9).

Tests:
- KnockbackRulesTests covers Doc 18 T01-T08 and T10-T14 at rule level,
  step sums, replacement restart and config validation (25/25 EditMode).

Refs: TASK-244
```

#### Original body

```text
Implement the authoritative hybrid dungeon collapse progression engine
according to Doc 20 §7-§8. The dungeon deterioration advances either by base
elapsed time or by instability points gained through PvE enemy defeats and
first acquisition of treasures.

Enforce design constraints:
- Discard instability overflow upon phase transition
- Saturate at threshold cap when phase minimum interval is pending
- Block early Collapse (E3) entry before the 08:00 mark
- Guarantee invariance of the 17:00 absolute closure time

Player-Added: Dungeon collapse progression accelerates dynamically based on monster kills and acquired treasures while preserving the 8-minute early collapse barrier and 17-minute final closure.
```

#### Original subject

```text
feat(utilities): implement rune compass and arcane detector
```

#### Original body

```text
Implement reusable expedition utilities for MVP (Document 14 §13):
- UTL_RUNE_COMPASS: instant activation with 30s cooldown providing 5s
  visual cardinal orientation towards the nearest POI.
- UTL_ARCANE_DETECTOR: 2.0s authoritative channel with 0.5x voluntary
  movement speed multiplier and damage interruption without penalty,
  revealing arcane elements within 10m for 5.0s on completion (20s CD).
- Instance cooldown persistence: preserves remaining cooldown tick on
  NetworkLootPickup when dropped, restoring remaining cooldown on pickup.
- MaxTransportable enforcement: validates MaxTransportable = 1 on
  PlayerLootReceiver, rejecting receiving duplicates.
- Reusable utilities: utilities are not consumed/deducted on activation.

Reviewers must verify:
- Rune compass shows nearest extraction sanctuary cardinal direction.
- Arcane detector channels and applies temporary cyan highlight to arcane items.
- Dropping an item on cooldown and picking it up preserves remaining recovery time.

Tests added:
- UtilityExpeditionRulesTests (cardinal math, names, arcane filters, transfer rejection)
- UtilityExpeditionPlayModeTests (compass orientation, detector channel, highlight, max transportable, drop/pickup cooldown persistence)

Player-Added: Rune Compass and Arcane Detector expedition utilities are now usable in raids.
```

```text
feat(quickslots): retain depleted slots and reject duplicate assignment
```

#### Original body

```text
Align Quick Slot rules with Document 14 §12:
- Retain depleted slots with count 0 and inactive state instead of
  unassigning them, automatically reactivating upon picking up units.
- Prevent duplicate assignment of the same item definition across
  multiple slots, returning QuickSlotAssignmentResult.AlreadyAssigned.
- Allow utilities (LootCategory.Utility) to be QuickSlotCompatible.
- Enable quick slot compatibility on UTL_RUNE_COMPASS and
  UTL_ARCANE_DETECTOR.

Reviewers must verify:
- QuickSlotController does not release bindings when inventory empties.
- RaidQuickSlotHudSlotView tints icon grayish when unavailable.

Tests updated & added:
- QuickSlotAssignmentRulesTests (duplicate rejection, retention)
- QuickSlotControllerTests (zero-count retention, refill reactivation,
  utility assignment)

Docs updated:
- LocalPlayerPersistenceArchitecture.md

Player-Improved: Quick slots keep empty items assigned at count 0 so you don't lose bindings when running out of potions.
```

### 384785d17e7749103d949529409dc6042c5ade53

[384785d17e7749103d949529409dc6042c5ade53](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/384785d17e7749103d949529409dc6042c5ade53)

Date: 2026-10-27T17:06:42-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Abilities, Inventory & Loot, Persistence & Backend, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(abilities): make Ability Vendor purchases authoritative and durable
```

#### Original body

```text
Move ability purchasing from local-only client simulation to an authoritative,
single-document atomic backend transaction. Add Character.unlockedAbilities
to the persistence schema and expose POST /character/me/abilities/purchase
with server-side pricing from ABILITY_CATALOG mirroring Unity catalog
assets. Validate funds, reservation state, revision conflicts, and duplicate
purchases with an idempotent receipt window.

On the client, introduce IAbilityPurchaseService and
RemoteAbilityPurchaseService to execute a preliminary local check,
await server confirmation, and commit local unlock, balance, and remote
revision. Update ApplicationStashServiceBootstrapper.HydrateSnapshot to
hydrate unlockedAbilities directly from the backend, discarding stale or
orphaned local unlocks and revalidating prepared abilities.

Tests:
- Backend: Parity check against Unity asset catalog (100% match).
- Backend: Unit tests covering atomic purchase, receipts, idempotency,
  pending reservation, revision conflict, already unlocked, and insufficient funds.
- Unity: EditMode tests for RemoteAbilityPurchaseService covering
  success, local rejection gates, backend errors, transport failures, and hydration.

Docs:
- Updated CommerceArchitecture.md and LocalPlayerPersistenceArchitecture.md.

Player-Improved: Abilities purchased at the Town Ability Vendor now save reliably to your account and remain unlocked across game sessions.
Refs: #596
```


```text
Remove WebhookSecret from BackendConfiguration asset and C# class,
ensuring client builds do not contain cluster signing secrets.
Implement Bounded Player-Host Authority in RaidResultService for the
client-hosted MVP topology: the backend authenticates the host via JWT,
requires active raid reservations on recipients, bounds loadout items to
30 slots, caps experience at 5,000 XP per raid, and rejects forged HMAC
signatures.

Update architecture documentation (ExtractionArchitecture,
RemoteIdentityAndAuthArchitecture, RaidParticipantArchitecture) and add
backend unit tests covering exploit rejections and legitimate bounded
extraction flows.

Refs: #595
```

```text
Update LootContainerContentRoller to evaluate an independent deterministic Chaos Coin roll stream (2000 basis points) isolated from Luck, allowing both bonuses to co-occur without mutating the base generation seed. Seal resolved loot sources against subsequent modifier re-evaluation.

Refs: #615
```

### 49de0efd345c37432f5e340a248df1a6679357fe

[49de0efd345c37432f5e340a248df1a6679357fe](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/49de0efd345c37432f5e340a248df1a6679357fe)

Date: 2026-10-26T19:26:43-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Inventory & Loot, Build & Tooling, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(loot): refactor taxonomy and item contracts with formal naming
```

#### Original body

```text
Align LootCategory enum and LootDefinition ScriptableObject contracts with the Doc 14 taxonomy and HacknPlan TASK-225 specifications. Introduce ItemUseMode and formal taxonomy properties (ObjectValue, StackMax, MaxTransportable, Family, Tags, and lifecycle flags) while preserving backward compatibility with existing equippables and serialized valuable assets.

Update LootDefinition ID regex validation to accept formal alphanumeric identifiers (e.g. CON_HEALTH_POTION), and enforce validation constraints for negative values, deprecated Quest category, and unstackable Treasure items. Add comprehensive EditMode unit tests covering all new validation gates and properties.

Refs: #611
```

```text
feat(ui): apply charcoal skin and single-image equipment slots
```

#### Original body

```text
Apply the approved charcoal atlas to menu, Town and Raid UI controls,
with nine-slice geometry and authored selectable state sprites.

Add editable 16x16 equipment category art at 16 PPU. Reuse each slot's
Icon for empty, equipped and reserved states, retaining authored item
and category geometry, opacity and existing interaction behavior.

Include composition/state tests, importer metadata and architecture
notes. Preserve the original editable atlas source with the UI assets.

Structural asset and serialization checks pass. Native Unity compilation,
reimport and current state tests remain pending because no Editor is
connected. Earlier atlas audit assumptions also need reconciliation
with the existing manually tuned frame density and panel variant.
```

```text
Add the hacknplan-task-design project skill under .agents/skills and
register it in the repository AGENTS.md.

Document strict guidelines for HacknPlan tags:
- Prohibit discipline or functional roles as tags (Arte, Level Design,
  Game Design, Programación, Backend), keeping them in title prefixes or
  category.
- Require uppercase Spanish system and area tags reflecting design docs.
- Re-use existing project tags and create uncataloged ones on demand
  (e.g., Catacumbas, Tileset, Combate, Loot, Colapso, Abatido,
  Presentación, Seguridad, Habilidades, Misiones).
- Document API endpoints for tag assignment and removal.
```

#### Original subject

```text
feat(equipment): add knockback reaction spritesheets and mappings for all armor sets
```

#### Original body

```text
Add pixel-matched 4-frame knockback spritesheets for all six armor sets
(Heavy Armor, Light Armor, Arcane Mage, Army Ranger, Fire Mage, Forest
Ranger) across five equipment parts and six facings.

Register 720 new sprite mappings across the 24 armor LootDefinition
assets so equipped armor pieces resolve smoothly through
PlayerArmorPresenter during knockback reactions without texture gaps.

Tests updated:
- ArmorSetCatalogTests (verified all 3,240 visual mappings across sets)

Player-Improved: Equipped armor and robes now properly deform and match character movement during knockback reactions.
```

### a51a721ce19dd9c8d0ba12a8ca3702372265c1c6

[a51a721ce19dd9c8d0ba12a8ca3702372265c1c6](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/a51a721ce19dd9c8d0ba12a8ca3702372265c1c6)

Date: 2026-10-27T13:39:34-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Movement, Art & Animation, Build & Tooling, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(animation): add 6-directional player knockback reaction and runtime presentation
```

#### Original body

```text
Implement a 4-frame modular knockback reaction animation for all six
character facings (N, NE, NW, S, SE, SW), preserving independent body
parts and hand grips.

Add 18 animation clips driving base body transforms, hand positions,
and grip offsets across three controller layers. Wire network knockback
events through PlayerMovementNetworkController and PlayerAnimatorView.
Integrate knockback playback and idle recovery verification into the
attack animation validator tool.

Tests added:
- PlayerKnockbackAnimationTests (clip bindings, layers, and view playback)
- AttackAnimationValidator knockback cell and recovery tests

Player-Added: Added physical knockback reaction animations in all six directions when players receive knockback impulses.
```

### 74e9e910a90693465481e589e54238afae8a514a

[74e9e910a90693465481e589e54238afae8a514a](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/74e9e910a90693465481e589e54238afae8a514a)

Date: 2026-10-26T16:59:31-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Extraction, UI, World & Visibility, Art & Animation, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(minimap): render wall art from a 2x2 averaged tile atlas
```

#### Original body

```text
The minimap draws 8 PPU tile art at about 4 screen pixels per tile, so
Point sampling kept only one of every two 1-texel rows. Wall bases lost
their light edge and showed a dark band that the Tilemap does not have.

The layout generator now bakes an alpha-weighted 2x2 box-averaged copy
of each source atlas, decoded from the original PNG bytes, and stores it
as a Point/Clamp, mip-free sub-asset of the generated layout. Batches are
rebound to that copy with their original UVs. The source PNG and its
import settings are untouched. The hash version tag is bumped to
"scene-tile-art-v3-avg2", and a layout whose batches do not reference
embedded art is regenerated, so existing layouts migrate automatically.
A failed bake writes nothing and fails the prebuild gate.

This supersedes the previous rule that the minimap samples the original
textures without a baked copy.

Tests:
- MinimapArtDownsamplerTests: exact averaging, alpha weighting,
  transparent blocks, odd sizes rejected, Point/Clamp output
- GraphicUsesTheAveragedTileAtlasGeneratedInsideTheLayout replaces the
  original-atlas identity test

Docs: ExtractionArchitecture.md, RaidMainHudArchitecture.md and the
faithful-dungeon-minimap ODD log.

Player-Improved: Minimap walls now match the dungeon art instead of showing a dark band at their base.
```

### 7c43a127c470af0f1e2382ce0c53567a07723c40

[7c43a127c470af0f1e2382ce0c53567a07723c40](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/7c43a127c470af0f1e2382ce0c53567a07723c40)

Date: 2026-10-26T16:59:12-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: UI, Build & Tooling, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(minimap): snap the map in root canvas pixels to stop wall flicker
```

#### Original body

```text
The overlay HUD Canvas is parented to the moving NetworkPlayer, and
Unity does not re-centre an overlay canvas transform. Snapping the map
pivot in world space therefore assumed world == screen and left the map
at a fractional pixel equal to the player's fractional position, so the
point-sampled wall tiles blinked while moving.

Overlay canvases now round the map pivot in root-canvas pixel space
(canvas-local position minus rect origin, times scaleFactor), which is
independent of where the canvas sits in world space. Camera and world
space canvases keep the existing camera-based path.

Tests:
- MapPivotSnapsToCanvasPixelsWhenHudCanvasIsUnderAMovingParent (canvas
  scales 0.73, 1 and 1.37; failed with a 0.37 px drift before the fix)

Player-Fixed: Minimap walls no longer flicker while your character moves.
```

### e0b80b6519be585cc8f3bb00d44d08d31022373c

[e0b80b6519be585cc8f3bb00d44d08d31022373c](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/e0b80b6519be585cc8f3bb00d44d08d31022373c)

Date: 2026-10-26T01:00:37-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: Extraction, Networking & Sessions, World & Visibility, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(networking): fail closed on unverified identity and raid closure gaps
```

#### Original body

```text
- Town sender resolution and remote Raid admission now reject requests
  when no verifier is configured, instead of trusting unsigned tickets
  or client-declared admission data. Offline/no-backend development
  flows can no longer admit remote peers.
- Absolute Dungeon closure selects unresolved Raiding participants
  through AbsoluteClosureRules; a participant whose canonical defeat
  cannot complete stays tracked and logs an error instead of being
  dropped while still Raiding.
- DefaultDungeonPressureConfig uses 900 s before Collapse (15 + 2 min
  total); thresholds 240/60 and Collapse 120 unchanged.
- Reconnect ticket disposal uses the attempt-local shutdown reason and
  exception, so a stale terminal reason cannot discard a recoverable
  ticket.
- RaidPlayerDeparturePolicy drops the unused decider argument.

Tests (source-grep checks replaced by behavioural tests):
- RaidAdmissionSecurityTests: inflated client claims with no verifier
  are rejected (snapshot and ticket formats)
- TownIdentitySecurityTests: unsigned ticket for a victim profile with
  no verifier is rejected
- RaidAbsoluteClosureTests: Raiding-only selection regardless of
  connectivity or Downed; default asset totals 17 minutes
- RaidReconnectClientFlowTests: exception cannot reuse a previous
  terminal reason
- RaidPlayerDepartureTests, RaidExtractionConnectivityTests,
  RaidConnectivityContinuityTests: behavioural departure and
  extraction-connectivity rules

Docs: DungeonPressure timing and unresolved-defeat handling;
RaidConnectivityContinuity marks invalid-config disconnect as a
misconfiguration fail-safe.
```

[a43868e28ffab74d870a26e8702e82dd4621424c](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/a43868e28ffab74d870a26e8702e82dd4621424c)

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(backend): keep raid reward receipts as durable replay barriers
```

#### Original body

```text
Authoritative raid results expire after 24 h and extraction receipts
were evicted past 256 entries, so a consumed raid could be republished
and rewarded twice. Receipts are no longer pruned, the atomic commit
predicate rejects any existing receipt for the same raid, and
publication returns 409 RESULT_ALREADY_CONSUMED once the recipient has
a receipt for that raid.

Reviewers: receipts now grow with every extracted raid per character
(bounded by the Mongo document size).

Tests:
- extraction.authoritative: consumed raid cannot be republished after
  TTL deletion and receipt-cap pressure
- extraction.commit, inventory.extraction, raid.result updated for
  durable receipts
```

[feaedc7daa5a6dd70075de33706730749ec23153](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/feaedc7daa5a6dd70075de33706730749ec23153)

Date: 2026-10-26T00:59:59-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: Networking & Sessions, Persistence & Backend, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(backend): fail closed on missing NODE_ENV and spoofable proxy trust
```

#### Original body

```text
Startup now requires an explicit NODE_ENV, so a production deploy
without it can no longer skip the production secret guards. TRUST_PROXY
accepts only false or a hop count; `true` is rejected because it lets a
client spoof X-Forwarded-For and bypass the per-IP auth limiter.

Deployments must set NODE_ENV and a numeric TRUST_PROXY (e.g. 1).
Test scripts load tests/setup.js to supply synthetic configuration
instead of the local .env.

Tests:
- env.hardening: missing NODE_ENV, TRUST_PROXY parsing and rejection
- auth.hardening.integration: register limiter 429 + Retry-After with
  spoofed forwarded headers; debug and legacy routes 404 in production
- session.revocation: login after logout issues a working token while
  the old one stays revoked

Docs: US-60 walkthrough limits, logout signature and per-process
limiter limitation corrected.
```


```text
Add the client side of the per-account buy-back: DTOs and
ShopBuybackAsync, a memory-only BuybackLedger owned by the application
stash context and replaced from hydration, reconciliation and every
shop response, and a remote-first ExecuteBuybackAsync that dry-runs
gold, capacity and reservation locally, awaits the backend and applies
its authoritative totals. A new Town ticket clears the ledger, since it
starts a new backend epoch.

IBuybackEligibilityPolicy (equipment and weapons today) is a
presentation hint and the extension point for a stricter rule; the
backend stays authoritative.

Tests: buy-back success, rejection mapping, dry-run, replay, transport
loss and sale ledger replacement; ledger replacement and eligibility.
```

[5cd99fe01ed5686bca116b805effcbbe0471641e](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/5cd99fe01ed5686bca116b805effcbbe0471641e)

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(backend): let players buy back equipment they sold this Town session
```

#### Original body

```text
Selling an equipment piece now records a per-account buy-back entry
in the same atomic update as the sale, priced at ceil(sell value x
BUYBACK_PRICE_MULTIPLIER = 1.5) and capped at 16 entries, oldest
first. POST /character/me/inventory/shop/buyback rebuys from an entry
with the same receipt, reservation, revision and funds guards as the
shop. Issuing a Town session ticket starts a new buy-back epoch.

Eligibility is LootCategory 5-10 behind isBuybackEligible so a later
rule can replace it; the parity test checks it against the Unity
assets.

Tests: unit guard order and replay; MongoMemoryServer coverage for
FIFO, partial and full consumption, account isolation, epoch expiry
and write races.
```

### 4416f9d32c04d0bea53d3dd57fecf5a7e0d71015

[4416f9d32c04d0bea53d3dd57fecf5a7e0d71015](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/4416f9d32c04d0bea53d3dd57fecf5a7e0d71015)

Date: 2026-10-25T20:35:01-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: Networking & Sessions, Persistence & Backend, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(commerce): report trade outcomes only after backend acknowledgement
```

#### Original body

```text
Trades committed locally and synced fire-and-forget, so the merchant
authority consumed or restocked shared stock for trades the backend
later rejected, and the panel kept saying the trade succeeded.
ExecuteTradeAsync now dry-runs the ticket, awaits the backend and
commits locally only on acknowledgement; the trade session reports the
real outcome and keeps Confirm locked until then, which also stops a
quick second trade from sending a stale revision.

Also guard the merchant RPC handlers against a missing validator, fail
loudly when BackendConfiguration is missing, and correct the retry
claims in the service docs. A lost response still reports the trade as
not persisted; CommerceArchitecture.md records that gap.

Tests: RemoteShopTransactionServiceTests (acknowledgement, rejection
mapping, dry-run, transport loss, multi-line refusal) and session
tests for acknowledgement timing, serialization and disposal.
```

#### Original subject

```text
fix(commerce): reject trades while a raid reservation is pending
```

#### Original body

```text
TryCommitTrade skipped the Town mutation gate, so a trade during a
pending Raid loadout reservation could fill capacity and leave the
reservation impossible to roll back. New trades now return
ReservationPending, matching the backend 409 RESERVATION_PENDING;
already-applied receipts still replay as AlreadyApplied.

Tests: reservation rejection with rollback restoring the loadout,
receipt replay during a reservation, and ReservationPending in the
trade session rejection cases.
```

```text
fix(backend): reject shop trades while a raid reservation is pending
```

```text
loadout, so a rollback silently dropped the reserved items and the
extraction commit failed with LOADOUT_NOT_EMPTY. shopBuy and shopSell
now answer 409 RESERVATION_PENDING, also guard the atomic update, and
still replay already-applied receipts.

Tests: unit and MongoMemoryServer coverage for buy/sell rejection,
receipt replay during a reservation and a reservation created between
read and write.
```

#### Original subject

```text
feat(town): project member equipment into Preparation presentation
```

#### Original body

```text
Each Preparation member now carries what its card and the read-only
inspection need: ProfileId, whether it is the local member, and the
member's prepared Equipment for all eight slots with the observed
equipment revision.

- IPreparedEquipmentReader is the read seam implemented by
  SocialPlayerArmorEquipmentNetworkSource.
- TownPartyDirectory.TryGetPreparedEquipment resolves a member's
  reader from its SocialPlayer object, like TryGetDisplayName.
- TownRaidPreparationPresentation captures every slot at projection
  time; existing TryCreate overloads keep working without a resolver.
- TownRaidPreparationPresenter re-presents when a member's reader
  appears, disappears or its equipment revision changes, without
  waiting for a preparation snapshot revision.

Tests:
- TownRaidPreparationPresentationTests: member identity and IsLocal,
  captured weapon and armor slots with revision, missing reader,
  null resolver and capture independence.

Refs: TASK-219
```

#### Original subject

```text
feat(town): replicate full prepared equipment for inspection
```

#### Original body

```text
Extends the SocialPlayer equipment source so every Town peer receives
the full prepared Equipment of each member, which the Preparation
screen needs to inspect another member read-only.

- SocialPlayerArmorEquipmentNetworkSource now replicates all eight
  prepared slots (both Weapon Sets plus body armor) as catalog
  index + 1, with one EquipmentRevision bump per changed loadout.
- The IEquipmentVisualSource contract is unchanged: TryGetSlotDefinition
  still resolves only Helmet, Armor, Gloves and Boots, so Town never
  renders a held weapon.
- New TryGetPreparedSlotDefinition exposes all eight slots for
  read-only inspection only.

Tests:
- PlayerArmorPresenterTests: every prepared slot has a networked
  catalog index; an unspawned source exposes no definitions through
  either API.

Docs: LobbyAndSessionTransitionArchitecture.md SocialPlayer boundary
now allows weapon replication solely for read-only inspection.

Refs: TASK-219
```

### 06c164e9c6cf56cb0bceffd093b49c8097f6bc42

[06c164e9c6cf56cb0bceffd093b49c8097f6bc42](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/06c164e9c6cf56cb0bceffd093b49c8097f6bc42)

Date: 2026-10-25T04:32:29-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Inventory & Loot, Networking & Sessions, UI, Persistence & Backend, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(inventory): add manual sort, reserved 2H slot and Downed lock
```

#### Original body

```text
Completes the inventory functions required by the UI audit (3b.9 to
3b.12). No inventory surface sorts itself anymore: a Sort button on
the Stash and Loadout panels and on the shared Town/Raid inventory
applies the existing category-then-name rule only when pressed, and
new items append at the end.

- Stash and Loadout show their stored order. Sort is a LocalProfileStore
  permutation transaction sent remote-first through the order endpoint
  and the serialized StashTransferCoordinator queue; it is rejected
  while a reservation is pending and allowed while Ready. Take All and
  Leave All follow the stored order.
- The coordinator is now owned by ApplicationStashContext so the Stash
  screen and the Town inventory share one queue per profile.
- Raid keeps a presentation-local order seeded from the reserved
  Loadout; it is not replicated and not carried back on extraction.
- The Off Hand of a Set holding a two-handed weapon shows that weapon
  dimmed as reserved and refuses drops; the active Weapon Set is
  highlighted and the inactive one dimmed.
- While Downed the Raid inventory stays visible but read-only, with a
  visible reason, and recovers without reopening.
- Prefabs: Sort buttons added to StashInventory and RaidInventoryUI.

Tests:
- StashTransferCoordinatorTests, StashDisplayOrderTests: order
  transaction, remote-first Sort, reconciliation, stored bulk order,
  shared queue ownership.
- RaidInventoryDisplayOrderTests, DropPolicyTests: local order
  maintenance and reserved Off Hand refusal.
- Lobby Stash and Raid inventory PlayMode tests: Sort buttons, reserved
  slot, Set visuals and the Downed read-only block.

Docs: RaidInventoryUIArchitecture.md and
LocalPlayerPersistenceArchitecture.md document the order contract, the
queue ownership and the Downed block; the compact no-hole model is
recorded as approved design debt against GD 16 section 3.

Refs: TASK-218
Player-Added: Inventories and the Stash now have a Sort button, and items stay in the order you leave them.
Player-Improved: A two-handed weapon now shows its second hand slot as reserved, and the active weapon set is easy to spot.
Player-Improved: While downed you can still look at your inventory, but it clearly tells you it cannot be changed.
```

### c261944f2a77a8dfd242237b720e7c98ef2c5ffb

[c261944f2a77a8dfd242237b720e7c98ef2c5ffb](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/c261944f2a77a8dfd242237b720e7c98ef2c5ffb)

Date: 2026-10-25T04:31:56-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Inventory & Loot, Persistence & Backend, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(backend): persist player-controlled inventory order
```

#### Original body

```text
Adds an authenticated order write so the Stash and Loadout keep the
order the player chose instead of being sorted for display. The
backend stores the reordered array; no position field is added to
the item schema.

Contract: PUT /character/me/inventory/order with
{ list: "stash" | "loadout", lootIds, expectedRevision }. The list
must be an exact permutation of the current array (amounts kept,
other list untouched). Rejects with 409 RESERVATION_PENDING while a
reservation exists, 409 REVISION_CONFLICT on a stale or racing
revision, and 400 VALIDATION_FAILED for a malformed or mismatched
order. Returns { stash, loadout, revision } like the move routes.

Tests:
- inventory.order.test.js: stash and loadout reorder, invalid
  permutations, stale revision, pending reservation, atomic race and
  request validation.

Refs: TASK-218
```

```text
backend/src/routes/inventory.routes.js
backend/src/services/InventoryService.js
backend/src/validators/inventory.validators.js
backend/tests/inventory.order.test.js
```


#### Original body

```text
The Main Menu now follows the Game Design session rules. Without a
session it offers Log in, Settings, Credits and Exit, and Play is
visible but disabled. With a session Play is enabled and Log out
replaces Log in. A successful login or character creation now stays on
the menu instead of entering the Town automatically. Log out runs the
existing LoginFlowController logout and returns the menu to the
unauthenticated state, also on SessionInvalidated.

Settings and Credits open the shared overlay panels nested in the Main
Menu Canvas. Exit uses the new ApplicationExit helper, now shared with
the Town Options tab, through a replaceable QuitAction. The connection
status text is shown only while an operation runs or after an error.

Serialized wiring: Login Button and Logout Button added to ButtonHolder
in MainMenu.prefab, Play label renamed to "Jugar"; SettingsPanel and
CreditsPanel instances nested in MainMenu Canvas.prefab.

  states.
```

[9c26f5a8d315147502eed10cc22906d3a32c0538](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/9c26f5a8d315147502eed10cc22906d3a32c0538)

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(audio): persist master, music and SFX volume preferences
```

#### Original body

```text
AudioManager now remembers the normalized volume of each channel in
PlayerPrefs through AudioVolumeSettingsStore and re-applies the saved
values on Start. AudioMixer.SetFloat does not take effect in Awake, so
setter calls made before Start persist without touching the mixer.
The current normalized values are exposed read-only so a Settings
screen can initialize its sliders.

Values are clamped to 0..1 and default to 1 when nothing is saved.

Tests:
- AudioVolumeSettingsStoreTests: defaults, per-channel roundtrip and
  clamping on save and on load.

Refs: TASK-216
```

### 5ad42e1074adb1cf8478ed89b36f5c7e5ab7edc3

[5ad42e1074adb1cf8478ed89b36f5c7e5ab7edc3](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/5ad42e1074adb1cf8478ed89b36f5c7e5ab7edc3)

Date: 2026-10-25T00:46:09-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Abilities, Movement, Persistence & Backend, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(player): align player action rules with Game Design
```

#### Original body

```text
Correct four player behaviors that contradicted Game Design 04, 08 and
17 (TASK-221). Rules are enforced on the authoritative side, not only
in presentation.

- Attribute maximum is 30 (04 s8/s11, 08 s4) in Unity
  ProgressionBalanceDefaults and backend MAX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE. Loaders
  never clamp, so profiles at 25 keep loading and can rise to 30.
- Attribute assignment is rejected while Ready (04 s10/s12). New
  TownAttributeMutationEndpoint checks TownEquipmentMutationGate before
  the store, so a blocked attempt never reaches the backend commit. The
  panel disables every assignment while Ready and refreshes on open and
  after a blocked attempt.
- Sprint is suppressed every tick while a weapon attack or ability
  executes (17 s5/s9): no sprint speed, stamina spend or rejection
  telemetry. Held Sprint resumes when the action ends; base movement is
  unchanged.
- A basic attack during an executing ability is rejected with the new
  AttackFailureReason.AbilityInProgress (appended), on status,
  authoritative acceptance and the legacy path, without cancelling or
  queuing the ability (17 s7.3/s9).

Reviewers should verify: the Ready gate lives at the Unity mutation
boundary because the backend has no Ready state; movement (-10) runs
before combat (-7), so Sprint still applies on the attack start tick;
ability start during a basic attack remains a TASK-223 follow-up.

Tests: attribute maximum and former-maximum progression (Unity and
backend), TownAttributeMutationEndpoint Ready gate, presentation and
binding Ready refresh, sprint suppression during execution, and basic
attack rejection during an ability without cancel or queue.

Docs: PlayerMovement, PlayerCombat, AbilitySystem and Progression
architecture.

Player-Balanced: Each attribute can now be raised up to 30 instead of 25.
Player-Fixed: Attribute points can no longer be spent while you are marked as Ready for an expedition.
Player-Fixed: Attacking or using an ability while sprinting now stops the sprint, and you can no longer start sprinting in the middle of an attack.
Player-Fixed: Pressing attack while an ability is being cast no longer fires a basic attack on top of it.
```

### d2c0824cd5199ae0fa2a75dfd97b14ef9a0154bd

[d2c0824cd5199ae0fa2a75dfd97b14ef9a0154bd](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/d2c0824cd5199ae0fa2a75dfd97b14ef9a0154bd)

Date: 2026-10-24T23:55:14-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Inventory & Loot, Art & Animation, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(combat): add attack animation validator and fix off-hand attacks
```

#### Original body

```text
Add an Edit Mode Attack Animation Validator window and use it to fix the
off-hand and dual-wield attack presentation it exposed.

Validator (Tools/Animations/Attack Animation Validator):
- previews every legal equipment/action combination in six facings with
  VFX on the real NetworkPlayer prefab, with no runner or Play Mode;
- per-frame checks: weapon grip on hand, grip transform, hand sprite
  identity, body-side depth, hand occlusion (weapons only), VFX origin,
  return to idle, presentation configuration and slash arc contract;
- presenters read through a new IPlayerPresentationState seam;
  NetworkPlayerPresentationState keeps the runtime behavior.

Presentation fixes:
- off-hand clips derived from the main-hand sets (OffHandAnimationGenerator)
  with left-hand anchoring and transient pose ownership;
- Spellbook is two-handed (Main Hand only) and keeps its authored left
  hand; its off-hand set and clips were removed;
- front facings draw the off hand above its weapon (22 over 20); shields
  stay above their holding hand; back facings keep hands at -2 at rest;
- ArmingSword and MagicSword slash along one canonical body-frame arc
  in both hands (Main +135 -> -45 deg, Off reflected across the facing
  axis), keeping source timing and authored recovery endpoints; slash
  VFX poses recalibrated and reflected across the facing axis;
- two-handed secondary-grip weapons keep the left hand on the handle in
  idle, walk and attacks; bow holder hand sorts behind the body facing
  north; main-hand shield Defend keeps the right hand on the shield.

Reviewers should verify: Spellbook handedness contradicts GD-09 section 5
(1M) by team decision; ArmingSword main-hand clips no longer preserve the
authored swing curve (source clip still drives timing); off-hand format
off-hand-retarget/5.

Tests: presentation seam, off-hand retargeting and mirrored strokes,
canonical slash generation, validator checks, catalog, renderer, window
and frame cache, plus updated generator, shield and catalog tests.

Docs: PlayerCombatArchitecture.md and the validator README.

Player-Fixed: Off-hand weapon attacks now stay in the left hand and the fist is no longer hidden behind the weapon.
Player-Improved: Sword slashes in either hand now sweep in a natural arc from behind the body to the opposite side in every direction.
Player-Improved: Two-handed swords and hammers are held with both hands while standing and walking.
Player-Fixed: Raising a shield held in the right hand no longer separates the hand from the shield.
Player-Balanced: The spellbook is now a two-handed weapon and can only be equipped in the main hand.
```

```text
attribute-point badges and Town XP animation from committed progression.

gates and main-hand presentation. Add rival-only trap immobilization
with Purification cleanup/protection and restored deadlines.

coordinated Raid preparation. Include serialized composition, regression
tests and owning architecture documentation.

out of this commit through isolated prefab and source hunks.

plus 2/2 corrected rechecks; PlayMode 17/24 plus 1/1 corrected recheck.
```

#### Original subject

```text
test(playmode): compose a matching local profile for HUD binder fixtures
```

#### Original body

```text
LocalPlayerHudBinder.CreateQuickSlots requires an available
ApplicationStashContext whose ProfileId equals the LocalPlayerJoinContext
ProfileId. DefeatedPlayerLoot never initialized its join context or
composed a profile, and the Vitality HUD case composed none, so the binder
logged a Quick Slots error and each test failed on the unhandled log.

PlayModeLocalProfile builds an in-memory repository, store and stash
context, binds the same ProfileId to the runner's join context, and on
dispose destroys only its own context and re-enables any it suspended.
Both fixtures create it before the avatar spawns and dispose it in
teardown.

Validation: Vitality and 6 DefeatedPlayerLoot cases now pass; full PlayMode
741 passed, 31 failed, 2 skipped (was 733/39/2) with no Passed->Failed.
Remaining DefeatedPlayerLoot failures are independent and were masked.
```

Flags: secondary

#### Original subject

```text
test(networking): pin RPC send acceptance to the installed Fusion contract
```

#### Original body

```text
In Fusion 2.1.1 RpcBuilder.CheckSend returns RpcSendMessageResult.Sent (0)
for every queued message and the weaver only writes and sends the payload
when SendMessageResult is zero; MaskSent is never set on a real send. The
four request controllers already read this correctly, so their WasAccepted
predicate is unchanged.

The G17 case built its local-only result with the default SendMessageResult,
which equals Sent, so it modelled a successful remote send. It now carries
NoActiveConnections.

New EditMode RpcAcceptanceContractTests pin the contract across the loot
transfer, loot drop, weapon equipment and consumable controllers: queued
send accepted, local invocation accepted only with State Authority, and
every non-queued result rejected.

Validation: EditMode RpcAcceptanceContractTests 13/13; PlayMode
LootTransferPresentationQueue 5/5. A real Host/Client session was not run.
```

### 48ed3616ba136d1d99c48fa8c457cbc7c90bfca7

[48ed3616ba136d1d99c48fa8c457cbc7c90bfca7](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/48ed3616ba136d1d99c48fa8c457cbc7c90bfca7)

Date: 2026-10-21T09:24:17-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: Extraction, Inventory & Loot, World & Visibility, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(extraction): reserve each Sanctuary exclusively for one team
```

#### Original body

```text
Game Design 06 sections 10 and 12 reserve a Sanctuary for its owning
team and select only among free Sanctuaries. The assignment service
selected among every registered Sanctuary and ExtractionSanctuary
accepted a second team in a free slot (former divergence D-3), so two
teams could be assigned the same Sanctuary.

Selection now filters unreserved Sanctuaries in ascending identity
order into a reused buffer and applies the existing seeded policy to
the free count. When none is free, assignment fails closed with the
existing NoFreeSanctuary reason and the team keeps its pending request.
TryAssignTeam rejects a team while another holds a slot; the owner's
reservation stays idempotent and the networked slot layout is unchanged.

TeamExtractionProgress retries a pending request every tick, so
NoSanctuariesConfigured, NoFreeSanctuary, ReservationConflict and
existing-assignment failures are reported once per Raid generation and
retried attempts log nothing.

Tests:
- EditMode: TryAssignTeam_ReservesTheSanctuaryExclusivelyForItsOwningTeam,
  TryGetAssignment_ResolvesEachTeamToItsExclusiveSanctuary and the
  adapted ritual interaction case replace the D-3 sharing tests.
- PlayMode: the distinct-Sanctuary case forces a colliding session seed
  so exclusivity is exercised on every run; a new exhaustion case and
  the no-Sanctuary case assert that retries stay silent.

ExtractionArchitecture.md replaces D-3 with the exclusive reservation
contract and records that Level Design must provide one Sanctuary per
team until Game Design defines exhaustion.

Validation from native results: focused EditMode Scenario 122/0 and
extraction fixture 11/1 (remaining ExecutionWithoutStateAuthority is a
pending contract decision). Full EditMode 4162 passed, 5 failed (the
five known separately tracked failures). Full PlayMode 733 passed,
39 failed, 2 skipped (was 731/40/2), no Passed->Failed. Host and two
team manual validation remains pending.
```

```text
Expedition Progress contract (Game Design 06) instead of the retired
per-player model. The removed NetworkPlayerMelee prefab is replaced by
NetworkPlayer.

Progress tests compose the authoritative TeamExtractionProgress through
NetworkMatchController and an initialized NetworkSpawnManager per test;
composing them in SetUp broke the Gameplay scene test, because the
manager reacts to the scene load. A two-team launch roster with
affiliated, registered participants covers rival teams, and a helper
drives definitive Defeat through Downed.

Oracles derived from Game Design 06 and the catalog:
- another avatar of the same team observes the shared pool; the
  former ResetsOnNewInstance case is renamed to
  TeamProgress_AllowsSameTickContributionsSaturatesAndPersistsAcrossAvatars;
- an enemy player grants PvP progress only at definitive Defeat;
- a Downed initiator keeps the ritual running, and the definitive
  Defeat of every team member cancels it;
- the rival in another team cannot appropriate the owner's Sanctuary;
- natural pickups contribute the catalog ExtractionValuePerUnit.

no Passed->Failed. QuotaCompletion_AssignsDistinctSanctuaries passed
only by chance with a random session seed, and WithoutSanctuaries and
ExecutionWithoutStateAuthority still fail.

Test-only change; no runtime behavior, prefabs or scenes change.
```

[b2923a2e7418d55e061ccf5f7960ab6b13b718ba](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/b2923a2e7418d55e061ccf5f7960ab6b13b718ba)

Date: 2026-10-21T02:05:17-03:00 · Classification: Tests (explicit) · Systems: Extraction, Networking & Sessions, Tests

Flags: secondary

#### Original subject

```text
test(playmode): compose team extraction progress for XP fixtures
```

#### Original body

```text
Add a runner-scoped in-memory ITeamExtractionProgress and a
PlayModeRunnerComposition helper that registers it in the fixture's
EntityRegistry, rejecting a missing registry or a second registration.
Since the team pool contract, avatar contributions log an error when no
team progress exists; the double avoids spawning NetworkMatchController,
whose Dungeon Pressure and reinforcement directors add unrelated
simulation.

FirstOpenExperience composes the team pool. KillExperienceSource also
composes a NetworkSpawnManager initialized for the runner, which kill
and assist sources use to resolve participants; its absence threw a
NullReferenceException in every test setup.

Tests: two composition tests cover the missing registry, the runner
singleton and per-team accumulation.

Validation from native results: focused 27 passed / 0 failed. Full
PlayMode 724 passed, 47 failed, 2 skipped (was 700/69/2): 22
Failed->Passed (6 FirstOpenExperience, 16 KillExperienceSource), 2 new
passing tests and no Passed->Failed.

Test-only change; no runtime behavior, prefabs or scenes change.
```


#### Original body

```text
Instantiate the player under a temporary inactive parent and disable its
InputSystemUIInputModule before activation. InputTestFixture keeps action
states resolved before its Setup, so the HUD module re-enabled the shared
DefaultInputActions with controls of real devices and every SetUp threw
IndexOutOfRangeException in InputManager.AddStateChangeMonitor whenever a
predecessor had enabled and released those actions (LootPickupFeedback,
HubSessionLauncher). Awake and OnEnable still run for the rest of the
player, and the existing SetActive(false) is unchanged.

Validation from native results: fixture alone 38 passed / 1 failed;
LootPickupFeedback + fixture 42/1 (was 4/39); Hub + fixture 38/2 (was
0/40). Full PlayMode 700 passed, 69 failed, 2 skipped (was 662/107/2):
38 Failed->Passed, all in this fixture, and no Passed->Failed. The
remaining fixture failure is the pre-existing
LocalInteractPress_WhileInPersonalMode assertion.

Test-only change; no runtime behavior, prefabs or scenes change.
```

#### Original subject

```text
feat(dungeon-pressure): add ambient lighting and phase presentation
```

#### Original body

```text
Implement ambient environmental presentation for Dungeon Pressure
phases. DungeonPressureAmbientPresenter translates replicated phase
transitions into smooth global lighting transitions and camera shake
effects (entry, continuous baseline rumble, and periodic tremors).

Local light props (torches, braziers) are modulated via
DungeonLightProp and DungeonLightPropRegistry, applying phase-dependent
color, intensity, and temporal patterns (Steady, TorchFlicker,
UnstableFlicker, Pulse). Late join and host migration apply current
ambient states without false transition shakes.

Tests:
- DungeonAmbientConfigTests: verify phase settings and clamps.
- DungeonLightPropTests: verify prop config and registry lifecycle.
- DungeonPressureAmbientPresenterTests: verify phase and periodic shake.

Docs:
- DungeonPressureArchitecture.md: document ambient communication.

Player-Added: Dungeon lighting darkens and shifts toward crimson as the instance nears collapse, accompanied by tremors and flickering torches.
Refs: US-53, TASK-193, #479
```

```text
camera rumble effects (such as environmental earthquakes or tremors) that
```

### 24d88d867cd446299d99b945570dcf3fe9c6dea0

[24d88d867cd446299d99b945570dcf3fe9c6dea0](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/24d88d867cd446299d99b945570dcf3fe9c6dea0)

Date: 2026-10-23T00:44:20-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Inventory & Loot, Networking & Sessions, World & Visibility, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(dungeon-pressure): defeat remaining raiders upon collapse expiry
```

#### Original body

```text
Enforce absolute dungeon closure upon Collapse expiry, transitioning
remaining raiding participants to definitive defeat rather than aborting
the match prematurely. When the 2-minute Collapse countdown elapses,
connected and disconnected raiders are definitively resolved, generating
their corpse loot and finalizing match results once.

Collapse duration defaults to 120 seconds in DungeonPressureConfig and
DefaultDungeonPressureConfig. Networked CollapseRemainingTicks
decrements only during the Collapse phase and synchronizes across host
migration. DefeatRemainingRaidingParticipantsForAbsoluteClosure in
NetworkSpawnManager filters only active Raiding participants, clearing
downed status and invoking HandleDeath() without cancellation aborts.

Tests:
- DungeonPressureClockTests: verify collapse countdown and stop.
- DungeonPressureConfigTests: validate positive collapse duration.
- RaidAbsoluteClosureTests: verify definitive defeat and triggers.

Docs:
- DungeonPressureArchitecture.md: document collapse deadline contract.

Player-Added: When the dungeon collapses after time runs out, remaining raiders are definitively defeated and leave their corpses behind.
Refs: US-53, TASK-192, #478
```

#### Original subject

```text
fix(raid): preserve reconnect tickets and unify disconnect continuity
```

#### Original body

```text
Remediate US-52 defect backlog (#559-#562):

1. Distinguish terminal from transient reconnect shutdown reasons in
   SessionConnectionCoordinator to preserve valid tickets upon network
   timeouts.
2. Resolve 0% provisional XP retention for defeat confirmed while
   disconnected or absent per Game Design Doc 05 §4 & §11.
3. Keep disconnected Raiding participants retained in dungeon consuming
   budget regardless of whether an eligible teammate decider exists per
   Game Design Doc 06 §18 & §19.
4. Align RaidConnectivityContinuityArchitecture with team extraction
   contracts under US-53 (TASK-190, TASK-191).

Player-Fixed: Disconnecting while solo or after a teammate dies now keeps your character recoverable within the reconnection window instead of evicting immediately.
Player-Fixed: Temporary connection dropouts during raid reconnection no longer discard the ability to retry reconnecting.
```

#### Original subject

```text
fix(networking): chunk raid admission payload and enable rollback
```

#### Original body

```text
Resolve multiplayer raid connection timeout and loadout loss caused by
Fusion 512-byte RPC limit and unhandled reservation cancellations.

- Unity Networking: RaidAdmissionPayloadChunking splits payloads into
  384-byte chunks; NetworkMatchController transmits via
  RpcSubmitRaidAdmissionChunk and reassembles on State Authority.
- Unity Session: FusionSessionLauncher integrates authoritative ticket
  acquisition and loadout verification; SessionConnectionCoordinator
  triggers RollbackPendingReservationAsync upon aborted launches.
- Backend Inventory: InventoryService and SessionTicketService equip
  arming_sword as recovery weapon when main hand is unequipped, and
  support rollback to restore items on reservation cancellation.

Tests added:
- Unity EditMode: RaidAdmissionPayloadChunkingTests (6).
- Backend: inventory.service.test.js, admission.integration.test.js.

Player-Fixed: Joining a multiplayer raid with a full loadout no longer gets stuck on the loading screen.
```


#### Original body

```text
Implement JWT revocation, in-memory rate limiting, production error
sanitization, and Unity 401 session invalidation for US-60 (#528).

- Backend Auth: Add RevokedToken model and authenticate middleware
  check; register/login tokens include unique jti claims;
  POST /auth/logout stores revoked jti with TTL index.
- Backend Hardening: MemoryRateLimiter and UserFailedLoginLimiter
  protect authentication and mutation endpoints; errorHandler sanitizes
  500 errors; env.js strictly validates WEBHOOK_SECRET in production.
- Unity Session Handling: ApplicationAuthContext handles 401
  UNAUTHORIZED by clearing auth state, resetting stash services, and
  firing SessionInvalidated; RemoteInventoryService and
  RemoteShopTransactionService catch 401 responses.

- Backend: session.revocation.test.js, rate.limiter.test.js,
  env.hardening.test.js, auth.hardening.integration.test.js.
- Unity EditMode: AuthenticationSecurityTests (6),
  BackendErrorUtilityTests, HydrateSnapshotTests.
```

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(security): enforce fail-closed verification for town and raid admission
```

#### Original body

```text
Enforce fail-closed cryptographic verification of town session tickets,
authoritative raid admission tickets, and continuity gates for US-59 (#527).

- Unity Town: TownSenderIdentityValidator fails closed while
  verification tasks are in-flight, caching results in
  BackendTownSessionTicketVerifier and pre-warming verification across
  RPC targets.
- Unity Raid: NetworkSpawnManager defers remote participant admission
  until backend admission verification completes, rejects unauthenticated
  client-declared payloads, validates reservation proof on reconnects,
  and rejects expired host migration tokens.
- Wiring: ApplicationAuthContext registers verifiers upon login;
  HubSessionLauncher refreshes expiring town tickets.

Tests added:
- Unity EditMode: TownIdentitySecurityTests (pending task fail-closed),
  RaidAdmissionSecurityTests (deferred verification, expired tickets,
  unauthenticated payload rejection), RaidContinuitySecurityTests.

Docs updated:
- RemoteIdentityAndAuthArchitecture.md

Refs: #527, #541, #542, #543
```

### 19b1208a4cc5597e75ff6da221d32d4933e09022

[19b1208a4cc5597e75ff6da221d32d4933e09022](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/19b1208a4cc5597e75ff6da221d32d4933e09022)

Date: 2026-10-20T15:59:32-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Abilities, Inventory & Loot, Networking & Sessions, Persistence & Backend, Art & Animation, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(security): authenticate town identity and authoritative raid admission
```

#### Original body

```text
Close client-side identity spoofing in Town and enforce authoritative
backend snapshot admission and continuity in Raid for US-59 (#527).

- Backend: HMAC-SHA256 session tickets (/session/ticket) and raid
  admission tickets (/raid/admission-ticket) validated via timing-safe
  comparisons with active Character nonces.
- Unity Town: TownSenderIdentityValidator validates town tickets on
  RPCs (Party, Merchant, RaidPreparation), rejecting spoofed
  PlayerRefs.
- Unity Raid: NetworkSpawnManager and RaidAdmissionRules hydrate
  player stats, level/XP, abilities, and inventory exclusively from
  verified backend snapshots, rejecting client-declared payloads.
- Continuity: RaidReconnectPayload, RaidReconnectTicket, and
  NetworkSpawnManager require valid ReservationId proof for reconnects
  and preserve authoritative state during host migration.

Tests added:
- Backend: unit (session.ticket.test.js) and integration
  (admission.integration.test.js) covering ticket lifecycle,
  tampering, and nonce rotation.
- Unity EditMode: TownIdentitySecurityTests (8),
  RaidAdmissionSecurityTests (6), and RaidContinuitySecurityTests (4).

Docs updated:
- LobbyAndSessionTransitionArchitecture.md
- RemoteIdentityAndAuthArchitecture.md

Refs: #527, #540, #541, #542, #543
```

### 41e791a17136a3dc16a3aeec2531c69b44bad8fb

[41e791a17136a3dc16a3aeec2531c69b44bad8fb](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/41e791a17136a3dc16a3aeec2531c69b44bad8fb)

Date: 2026-10-19T00:25:14-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Inventory & Loot, UI, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(downed): add Downed and revive feedback HUD for both participants
```

#### Original body

```text
The Downed player and the reviver now see the recovery state at all
times: the Downed Health reserve (draining, paused while recovering),
revive progress, an ally-Downed/in-range hint for the reviver, and a
notice with the cause when a revive is interrupted or completed. A
Downed target now shows "Mantener para reanimar" instead of the shared
avatar corpse prompt.

Contract to verify: PlayerDownedRecoveryNetworkController gains a
presentation-only outcome record (LastOutcomeKind, LastOutcomeReason,
LastOutcomeReviverId, LastOutcomeSequence), written by State Authority
just before the session is cleared. Presenters edge-detect on the
sequence and baseline silently, so late join, rebind and restore never
replay an outcome. Revive durations, ranges and rules are unchanged.
The notice is suppressed once the Downed player is defeated.

Tests:
- DownedRecoveryFeedbackTests: progress/reserve clamping, messages,
  outcome tracker baseline.
- DownedHudPrefabCompositionTests: NetworkPlayer wiring, hidden start.
- PlayerDownedRecoveryPlayModeTests: outcome per interruption cause,
  progress, Downed-side and reviver-side HUD, silent rebind.

Docs: DownedAndReviveArchitecture (outcome record, status) and
RaidMainHudArchitecture (Downed HUD section, limitations).

Host/Client, late join and Host Migration are not validated yet.
```

### ad8d42445e1e6ec3732871f37488c0d2e5391be4

[ad8d42445e1e6ec3732871f37488c0d2e5391be4](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/ad8d42445e1e6ec3732871f37488c0d2e5391be4)

Date: 2026-10-18T21:25:17-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Abilities, Inventory & Loot, Networking & Sessions, UI, World & Visibility, Art & Animation, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(ui): add animated feedback for controls, panels and scene fades
```

#### Original body

```text
Implement TASK-158. UI screens now give local, presentation-only
feedback: hover and press scale on buttons and toggles, fade
transitions when panels open and close, success and rejection pulses
on confirmed results, and a full-screen fade between scenes. Nothing
is networked or persisted, and no component changes Time.timeScale,
so screens used during gameplay never imply a pause.

- Timing lives in small pure states (UiEasing, UiPanelTransitionState,
  UiPointerResponse, UiPulseState, SceneTransitionFadePolicy) driven
  by UiButtonFeedback, UiPanelTransition, UiFeedbackPulse and
  SceneTransitionFader using unscaled time.
- Views keep owning their visibility: they call
  UiPanelVisibility.SetVisible/IsVisible instead of SetActive/activeSelf.
  A root without UiPanelTransition still toggles immediately.
- SceneTransitionFader is nested under the session coordinator in
  Systems.prefab and only observes StateChanged.
- UiButtonFeedbackInstaller adds UiButtonFeedback to the Buttons and
  Toggles authored in UI prefabs and open scenes (idempotent).
- Prefabs were updated by the installer and by re-serializing the UI
  prefabs, so the diffs are large and mostly additive.

Verify: layout and timing were not reviewed in the Game view as part of
this commit.

Tests: EditMode state tests (UiAnimationStateTests) and PlayMode panel
transition tests (UiPanelTransitionPlayModeTests), category TASK158.

Docs: UiFeedbackArchitecture (new), TownPlayerMenuArchitecture and
LobbyAndSessionTransitionArchitecture.
```

### aa7458c17e00ebee304f8786377e1824950e8a73

[aa7458c17e00ebee304f8786377e1824950e8a73](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/aa7458c17e00ebee304f8786377e1824950e8a73)

Date: 2026-10-18T21:21:11-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Abilities, Extraction, Inventory & Loot, UI, World & Visibility, Persistence & Backend, Input, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(inventory): add the four player Quick Slots
```

#### Original body

```text
Implement TASK-214 (#563). A Quick Slot references a loot definition,
never a stack, so assigning, moving or clearing one never touches item
identity, Origin, amount or location. Players can use a consumable with
a shortcut without opening the Inventory.

- Bindings live in the local profile (schema 9, local only, empty when
  loading older schemas) and survive Town -> Raid -> Town. Changing them
  is not blocked by Ready or a pending reservation.
- LootDefinition gets QuickSlotCompatible, valid only with a
  ConsumableDefinition. The Health Potion is the first compatible item.
- QuickSlotController validates assignment against the inventory the
  player is looking at and unassigns a slot when its last unit is seen
  leaving. QuickSlotReleaseGate keeps bindings through extraction,
  defeat, voluntary abandon, Downed and reservations.
- Shortcuts 1-4 go through PlayerConsumableNetworkController, so they
  share the Inventory's authoritative validation and rejections. They
  never fire while gameplay input is suppressed (Inventory or menus).
- Consumption now spends Player-origin units before Dungeon ones, also
  from the Inventory. The selection order is separate from the canonical
  bucket order, so RaidLootOriginTransfer validation is unchanged.
- Assignment by drag or context menu in the Inventory (Raid and Town);
  a provisional four-slot HUD row in NetworkPlayer.prefab.
- Weapon Set A/B moved from keys 1/2 to mouse wheel up/down.

Verify: the Inventory screen prefab (RaidInventoryUI.prefab) is not part
of this commit, so the four inventory slot views are still unassigned
there. The HUD and inventory layouts are provisional and not checked in
the Game view. Host/Client consumption is not yet validated.

Tests: assignment rules, controller (amounts, depletion, transient
empty inventory), release gate, schema 9 codec and store, Origin
selection order, DropPolicy and HUD prefab wiring. The corrupt-login
recovery tests now derive schema versions from CurrentSchemaVersion.

Docs: RaidMainHud, RaidInventoryUI, LocalPlayerPersistence and
LootInteraction architectures.
```

### 7b35062c3bc36719b808ffd280a498260058b3f9

[7b35062c3bc36719b808ffd280a498260058b3f9](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/7b35062c3bc36719b808ffd280a498260058b3f9)

Date: 2026-10-17T01:55:05-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: World & Visibility, Art & Animation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(tilemap): pack the provisional tileset into a padded sprite atlas
```

#### Original body

```text
Thin dashed lines flickered over the Gameplay tilemap while the camera
moved. The 8x8 provisional tileset has no spacing between tiles, and
the camera maps one texel to a non-integer number of screen pixels, so
point sampling at a tile edge could read the neighboring tile (e.g. the
brick wall edge bleeding into the floor tile). Vision Fog was not
involved: the lines also appear with the fog renderer disabled.

Add a Sprite Atlas V2 for the tileset with 4 px padding. The packer
extrudes each tile's border into the padding, so edge samples stay on
the same tile.

Atlas settings to verify: padding 4, tight packing and rotation off,
Point filter, no mipmaps, uncompressed, included in build. The source
PNG, its sprites and GUIDs, the camera and Vision Fog are unchanged.

Validated in Play Mode with a camera glide test (fog off, 4 glides x 40
frames): 1688x807 went from 6/149 frames with seams to 0/160, 1920x1080
from 1/149 to 0/160; a static frame comparison shows an identical
tilemap.
```

### 5ec3ccfce71078f0c7e448c20f5dce95d67206c2

[5ec3ccfce71078f0c7e448c20f5dce95d67206c2](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/5ec3ccfce71078f0c7e448c20f5dce95d67206c2)

Date: 2026-10-19T16:10:17-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Extraction, Inventory & Loot, Persistence & Backend, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(extraction): authenticate raid results and enforce single consumption
```

#### Original body

```text
Eliminate truncated signature vulnerability and multi-sequence replay
exploit on authoritative extraction results for US-58 (#526).

- Backend: deterministic pipe-delimited canonical signing covering raidId,
  resultId, targetIdentifier, sorted lootId items, 8 equipment slots,
  experienceGranted, and issuedAt;
- Backend: HMAC-SHA256 constant-time verification with 401 on tampering;
  409 on result conflicts and republication of consumed results;
- Backend: atomic distributed lock on AuthoritativeExtractionResult
  consumption preventing double dipping via sequence incrementing;
- Unity: RaidResultCanonicalizer helper for canonical string generation
  and HMAC calculation, matching backend verification exactly;
- Architecture: documented producer boundary and residual Host simulation
  risk in relation to Dedicated Server tech debt (#400);
- Tests: added unit, replay exploit, E2E integration, and EditMode suites.
```

### cb066c32b24c8ab72d47dc35b9f6c17e0647a1a5

[cb066c32b24c8ab72d47dc35b9f6c17e0647a1a5](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/cb066c32b24c8ab72d47dc35b9f6c17e0647a1a5)

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(shop): enforce authoritative catalog pricing and receipt binding
```

#### Original body

```text
Eliminate trust in client-declared prices and sell values by enforcing
server-authoritative pricing derived from GD-14, safe integer bounds
on transaction amounts, and strict intent-to-receipt binding.

- Introduce backend/src/config/shopCatalog.js defining authoritative
  buy prices, sell values, and MAX_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT (999).
- Update InventoryService and inventory.validators to compute transaction
  totals server-side, enforce atomic currency conditions in MongoDB, and
  prevent transaction ID reuse across mismatched payloads.
- Update Character model to persist lootId, amount, and totalAmount in
  shopReceiptSchema.
- Update Unity InventoryDataTransferObjects, InventoryClient, and
  RemoteShopTransactionService to submit pure transaction intent.
- Align HealthPotion buy value to 20 gold and fix Merchant prefab path
  in EditMode tests.
- Add unit tests in backend/tests/inventory.shop.test.js and E2E MongoDB
  integration tests in backend/tests/integration/shop.authoritative.test.js.
- Document authoritative contract in CommerceArchitecture.md and
  docs/plan_us57_shop_autoritativo.md.

Player-Fixed: Prevent modified game clients from forging shop prices or item quantities.
```

```text
extraction, and harden runtime sanctuary assignment resilience (TASK-190,

  standalone initialization to ensure reliable sanctuary assignment upon
  quota completion.

  ExtractionSanctuaryAssignmentService, and TeamExtractionProgress for
  unmanaged Fusion slot state inspection in Play Mode.
```

#### Original subject

```text
feat(extraction): implement team extraction coordinator and joint countdown
```

#### Original body

```text
Implement TeamExtractionCoordinator and joint countdown resolution for US-53 (TASK-191). Extraction countdowns are now managed authoritatively per team, requiring all active and connected members inside the assigned sanctuary zone.

Reviewers should verify:
- TeamExtractionSlot (INetworkStruct) tracks per-team active zone, countdown timer, and composition signature.
- TeamExtractionCoordinator (NetworkOrder(115)) manages per-team slots, evaluates requirements with TeamExtractionRequirementRules, and enforces fail-closed connectivity checks.
- Countdown restarts immediately upon team composition changes (D-4) and cancels immediately if any required member leaves or disconnects (A-5).
- Downed teammates can extract when inside the zone and connected.
- All qualified members extract simultaneously in the same tick upon timer expiration.
- Individual countdown initiation in PlayerExtractionController is disabled; all transitions are driven by TeamExtractionCoordinator.
- NetworkMatchController.prefab includes TeamExtractionCoordinator configured with ExtractionConfig.
- EditMode test suite added in TeamExtractionCoordinatorTests.cs (11 unit tests covering solo, duo, disconnects, downed, and composition change flows).
```

```text
- Gate ExtractionZone availability on sanctuary.IsAnyRitualCompleted.
```
