```text
feat(extraction): network team extraction progress pool and forwarder
```

#### Original body

```text
Implement the authoritative team extraction progress pool for US-53
(TASK-190 part 1), replacing per-player replicated progress with a
shared networked pool and turning PlayerExtractionProgressController
into a forwarder.

Reviewers should verify:
- TeamExtractionProgress (NetworkBehaviour on NetworkMatchController)
  maintains [Networked, Capacity(16)] NetworkArray<TeamProgressSlot>.
- TeamProgressSlot is an INetworkStruct storing TeamIdRaw,
  CurrentProgress, AssignmentRequested, and InitialTeamSize; quota is
  derived dynamically from ExtractionConfig and never replicated.
- EntityRegistry manages ITeamExtractionProgress capability with
  isolated registration and runner-scoped singleton lookup.
- NetworkSpawnManager exposes TryGetRaidTeamRoster projections from
  launch context.
- PlayerExtractionProgressController validates vitality, tick, and
  authority locally, then forwards contributions to team progress.
  Individual [Networked] properties are removed in favor of snapshot
  delegates.
- Documented intermediate state: completedQuota continues to trigger
  individual sanctuary assignment until team assignment in Stage 4.
- SessionConnectionCoordinator exposes _developmentTeamSize to group
  direct development cohorts into teams of N (default 0 preserves
  Team 1 for all).

Tests added and verified:
- TeamExtractionProgressTests: solo/duo quota derivation, single pool
  accumulation, saturation at quota, isolated team pools, and invalid
  contribution rejection.
- PlayerExtractionProgressForwarderTests: forwarder snapshot
  delegation, quota fallback, and assignment trigger.
- ExtractionProgressRegistryTests: registration, conflict rejection,
  and singlet lookup for ITeamExtractionProgress.
- ExtractionProgressPrefabTests: NetworkMatchController prefab baked
  TeamExtractionProgress component with ExtractionConfig reference.

Docs:
- Project Grimhold/Docs/Walkthroughs/US-53/Etapa-3-reserva-progreso-por-equipo.md
```

```text
feat(extraction): add pure domain contracts and team quota rules for shared extraction
```

#### Original body

```text
Introduce pure C# contracts, domain models, and validation rules for team-based shared extraction under US-53 (TASK-190 & TASK-191).

Adds RaidTeamRoster pure projection enforcing MVP team size limits (Solo/Duo, rule A-1) and raid team capacity (rule A-2).
Adds ExtractionTeamQuotaRules configuring Solo (100) and Duo (150) progress quotas.
Adds TeamRitualRules for authoritative ritual initiation and member survival cancellation rules (rules A-4, D-5).
Adds TeamExtractionRequirementRules evaluating team presence, fail-closed disconnection handling, Downed member extraction (rule D-6), and composition signature restarts.
Updates ExtractionConfig and ExtractionConfig.asset with Duo quota (150) and max teams per raid (4).
Updates ExtractionArchitecture.md documenting team extraction contracts and divergence D-3 (shared sanctuaries).
Adds EditMode test coverage for all new pure models and rules.
```

```text
does not fail before the player files exist.
```

[eb61577e05bf5825a8b0d4976f2d502886bd6cf5](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/eb61577e05bf5825a8b0d4976f2d502886bd6cf5)

Date: 2026-10-14T23:02:05-03:00 · Classification: Architecture & Infrastructure (explicit) · Systems: Build & Tooling, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
ci(changelog): automate developer and release changelog publication
```

#### Original body

```text
Regenerate CHANGELOG_DEV.md on every push to New-Testing and push it
back only when it changed. Bot commits use chore(changelog) and
[skip ci]; GITHUB_TOKEN pushes trigger no workflow and the generator
ignores them, so updates cannot loop.

Pull requests to New-Testing run the generator tests and fail on
invalid Player-* trailers in their own commits, with a notes preview
in the job summary. Publishing a vX.Y.Z release from New-Testing
validates its notes, commits all changelog files, replaces the release
body with the player notes and attaches changelog-players.json.

Add release-notes --strict, scoped to the commits of that release.
```

#### Original subject

```text
feat(changelog): add Git-based player and developer changelog generator
```

#### Original body

```text
Add a zero-dependency Node tool under tools/changelog that builds
CHANGELOG_DEV.md from commit history and CHANGELOG.md plus
changelog-players.json from explicit Player-* commit trailers.

Versions come from strict vX.Y.Z tags merged into the target ref;
untagged commits stay in Unreleased and never reach player files.
Player notes support human-reviewed overrides per commit, drop notes
of commits reverted within the same release and are deduplicated.
Developer entries keep commit links, skip merges and automation
commits, and merge cherry-picked duplicates into one entry.

Add 86 node:test cases for parsing, classification, overrides,
rendering, schema validation and temporary-repository CLI runs.
```

### 206dc0adf6350880ee574cdb9a8393975c23c7de

[206dc0adf6350880ee574cdb9a8393975c23c7de](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/206dc0adf6350880ee574cdb9a8393975c23c7de)

Date: 2026-10-14T16:46:26-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: Persistence & Backend, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(stash): accept over-capacity backend data and stop hydrating in place
```

#### Original body

```text
The backend has no Loadout slot limit, but the save codec rejected more
than 30 slots on every round-trip, so one over-capacity reconcile made
every later Commit fail. Login also hydrated repository.Snapshot in place
without saving it.

- Drop the 30-slot check from LocalProfileSaveCodec: capacity is a Store
  rule. Store operations that need a new slot already return InventoryFull,
  so the excess can only shrink.
- TryCreateLoadoutReservation refuses an over-capacity Loadout with
  InventoryFull so the excess never enters a raid.
- HydrateSnapshot validates the whole payload before writing: unknown
  LootIds and non-positive amounts are skipped, duplicates merged, and an
  amount overflow or negative currency rejects it without changes.
- Login hydrates a clone and persists it through TrySave.
- Document hydration and capacity in LocalPlayerPersistenceArchitecture.md.
```

### 703700cec8c9ae279792e9510514c78e08a61649

[703700cec8c9ae279792e9510514c78e08a61649](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/703700cec8c9ae279792e9510514c78e08a61649)

Date: 2026-10-14T15:27:33-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Inventory & Loot, Networking & Sessions, UI, Persistence & Backend, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(stash): coordinate Stash actions through a serialized, pre-checked queue
```

#### Original body

```text
- Move every Stash screen action (transfers, Take All / Leave All, equip,
  unequip) out of the presenter into StashTransferCoordinator, which runs
  them through one queue so an equip never interleaves with a transfer
  that is waiting for the backend, and removes the presenter's async void
  handlers.
- Add dry-run evaluators to the Store and IPlayerLoadoutService so a
  transfer the Store would refuse never reaches the backend; a move into
  a full Inventory now reports StashOperationResult.InventoryFull instead
  of PersistenceFailed.
- Put the remote inventory service and the reconciliation service behind
  interfaces, and share the Town Ready gate between the Inventory and
  Stash screens through TownEquipmentMutationGate.
- Cover the evaluators, the coordinator (order, reconciliation, queue)
  and the real Stash prefab end to end; document the flow in the Raid
  inventory UI architecture.
```

### 5a5345c25c9293879c98385fb4e1b9670fdc6392

[5a5345c25c9293879c98385fb4e1b9670fdc6392](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/5a5345c25c9293879c98385fb4e1b9670fdc6392)

Date: 2026-10-14T15:08:42-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: Extraction, Inventory & Loot, Persistence & Backend, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(stash): reject Stash and Equipment mutations while a reservation is pending
```

#### Original body

```text
- A pending raid reservation owns Inventory and Equipment, but Stash
  transfers, equip-from-Stash and equipment assign/clear still ran. A
  later rollback overwrote their result (one unit lost in the repro) and
  a non-empty Loadout made the extraction commit fail.
- Gate those operations behind one Store helper that returns the new
  StashOperationResult.ReservationPending without changing or publishing
  anything, and make the transfers fail with InvalidInventory instead of
  throwing when the profile is unavailable.
- Cover every gated operation, the unit-conservation and extraction
  regressions, the lifted invariant after rollback and the unavailable
  profile; document the invariant in the persistence architecture.
```

```text
P-2, and P-3 policies.

  initiation guards, continuation cancellation, and registry cleanup.
```

### 4f497423617c46f5b8b9c680be10a5cca689c80a

[4f497423617c46f5b8b9c680be10a5cca689c80a](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/4f497423617c46f5b8b9c680be10a5cca689c80a)

Date: 2026-10-14T13:24:48-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Inventory & Loot, Networking & Sessions, UI, World & Visibility, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(raid): implement continue without teammate and forced defeat
```

#### Original body

```text
Implement the authoritative "Continue without teammate" decision and
forced definitive defeat flow (TASK-189) when a participant's reconnect
budget is exhausted.

State Authority validates initial affiliation and connection conditions
before executing definitive defeat without synthetic damage or Kill XP.
The absent player's inventory is converted into a lootable corpse at
their retained world position, and connectivity synchronizes the
confirmed absence. Re-connection requests for abandoned profiles are
rejected as terminal. The duo HUD exposes the decision button on budget
exhaustion, updates presentation to reflect abandoned status, and the
Town preparation view safely handles reconnect button assignments and
session recovery.

Reviewer checks:
- Corpse generation and loot container availability allow server
  invocation outside fixed simulation ticks.
- Survivor extraction quota remains immutable and unaffected.
- ReconnectBudgetConfig and DefaultDungeonPressureConfig should be
  reviewed or reverted to production timings prior to deployment.

Tests:
- RaidTeammateAbsenceExecutionTests: verifies absence decision
  validation, terminal registration, and execution idempotency.
- RaidTeammateHudTests: verifies "Compañero: Abandonado" presentation.

Docs:
- Docs/Walkthroughs/US-52/Etapa-3-Continuar-Sin-Companero.md
```

[bfb67b1cee76b274df998ffdc2c3150a48c3b36f](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/bfb67b1cee76b274df998ffdc2c3150a48c3b36f)

#### Original subject

```text
feat(raid): implement client reconnection flow and town opportunity UI
```

#### Original body

```text
Add durable client reconnection ticket persistence and town UI
opportunity flow for disconnected raid participants (US-52 / TASK-188).

Persist reconnect tickets in PlayerPrefs with profile verification and
TTL expiry so clients returning to Town can resume an active raid.
Expose reconnection and discard actions in TownRaidPreparationView,
cleanly shut down and restore Town upon reconnect failures, handle
GameNotFound as immediate terminal state, and disable scene takeover
in HubRunnerFactory to ensure clean Town scene reload.

Contracts and behavior:
- RaidReconnectTicketStore: durable local storage with 10-minute TTL.
- SessionConnectionCoordinator: ReconnectToRaidAsync, ticket lazy-load,
  discard handling, and safe Town recovery without scene takeover.
- HubSpawnSceneConfiguration: modulo indexing for arbitrary actor IDs.
- TownRaidPreparationView / Presenter: reconnect and discard actions.

Tests:
- Added RaidReconnectClientFlowTests (11 tests passing).
- Updated SessionCompositionConfigurationTests and state machine tests.
```

```text
Handle closed coordinated sessions as transient
```

#### Original body

```text
Coordinated raid clients now treat ShutdownReason.GameClosed like GameNotFound while the Host creates and loads a session, and they keep polling until a bounded timeout expires. This patch adds timeout-aware retry logic in SessionConnectionCoordinator, treats availability-only shutdowns as non-fatal in FusionSessionLauncher, updates the availability tests for GameClosed behavior, and documents the closed-and-hidden Host startup contract in the session transition architecture.
```

```text
Import the Catacombs base tileset sprite sheet and its Unity metadata, including multi-sprite slicing. Add generated Tile assets for each sliced sprite and create a Catacombs prefab/grid tilemap palette configured to use those tiles for level painting.
```

### 3267a7fda55e88c872f8b705908ecedc3dfe2207

[3267a7fda55e88c872f8b705908ecedc3dfe2207](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/3267a7fda55e88c872f8b705908ecedc3dfe2207)

Date: 2026-10-11T11:18:10-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Abilities, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(abilities): implement PvE protective orbs
```

#### Original body

```text
Add configurable avatar-owned orbital defense with per-slot networked
consumption and local presentation. Preserve remaining slots and tick
deadlines through host migration without separate NetworkObjects.

Intercept enemy projectiles and melee on physical orb collisions.
Apply attributed contact damage independently per orb, preserve the
effect through CC and Downed, and end it on expiry or definitive defeat.
Retain projectile affiliation after shooter death or despawn.

Compose the ability on NetworkPlayer and document its configuration.
Add deterministic, runtime, Host/Client and real migration coverage.

Validation: 211 focused EditMode tests, 136 ordinary ability PlayMode
tests, and two explicitly selected Photon network tests passed.
Legacy missing-prefab test failures remain outside TASK-203.
```

### 71e3212a25765893c25019cbc796c2b3953f8d61

[71e3212a25765893c25019cbc796c2b3953f8d61](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/71e3212a25765893c25019cbc796c2b3953f8d61)

Date: 2026-10-09T00:05:13-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Abilities, Movement, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(abilities): capture aim direction at accepted execution
```

#### Original body

```text
The ability runtime now reads the avatar's networked aim once, when an
execution is accepted, and commits it in AbilityExecutionSnapshot next to
the sequence, phase and cooldown. Behaviors receive it through the
snapshot, so Rebind and Host Migration restore it without re-reading.

- Resolve aim before payment, falling back to the character facing; an
  unusable direction rejects as AimUnavailable with no cost or cooldown.
- Clear the captured aim when the execution stops, after Stop receives it.
- Wire the movement controller on NetworkPlayer.prefab and validate it in
  Spawned().
- Cover the resolver, composition and runtime cycle (fixed aim, facing
  fallback, rejection, stop, state copy) with tests.
- Document the implemented capture in AbilitySystemArchitecture.md.
```

```text
feat(presentation): turn the aim stance arm rigidly about a torso pivot
```

```text
While the aim stance is held or an aimed shot is released, the left hand pivot, the right hand pivot and WeaponPose rotate together about a per-weapon torso pivot by the residual, so the weapon stays outward toward the aim instead of swinging around the holding hand. An outward offset knob, default 0 and ramped with the draw, extends the arm. Without the stance the pose is the baked one; the wand keeps its free arc.
```

#### Original subject

```text
feat(presentation): apply the aim residual of two-handed weapons only while aiming
```

#### Original body

```text
Bows, the crossbow and the staff use the AimStance mode: the body follows the replicated facing and the weapon takes the residual only while the aim stance is held or an attack faces the aim, otherwise the baked pose plays unchanged. The wand keeps the free arc. The attack VFX re-anchors when the weapon becomes aim-driven during an attack.
```

#### Original subject

```text
feat(movement): accept an aim stance for two-handed ranged weapons through simulation
```

#### Original body

```text
Holding the secondary action with a two-handed aim-stance weapon sets a replicated IsAimStance flag and makes the shared facing rule aim at the cursor, like an accepted shield defense. The stance needs an active phase, an alive and not downed player and no active shield. The flag is initialised only on non-restore spawns. Adds the AimStance weapon aim mode with validation.
```

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(combat): enable free aim and weapon-owned spawn points on the ranged weapons
```

#### Original body

```text
LongBow, CompoundBow, LightCrossbow, MagicWand and MagicStaff use free aim with an orbit radius and a projectile spawn distance equal to the radius plus the visual reach, so the shot leaves from the visual tip. The two-handed weapons get a secondary grip derived from the baked clips. A consistency test pins the visual origin to the gameplay spawn at eight aims.
```

#### Original subject

```text
fix(combat): apply player melee damage on an authoritative release tick
```

#### Original body

```text
Player melee now follows the ranged release model. Acceptance validates the swing, starts the cooldown and commits a networked MeleeAttackRelease; damage resolves when the release tick is reached, with the origin sampled at release and the weapon identity checked. A pending swing blocks new acceptance and is cancelled by downed, disabled, phase exit or weapon change. A zero delay still resolves on the acceptance tick. Melee presentation enters the timed path through HasReleaseTimeline.
```

### bf204d41ca806ba1b645a916a1a321640183c2a4

[bf204d41ca806ba1b645a916a1a321640183c2a4](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/bf204d41ca806ba1b645a916a1a321640183c2a4)

Date: 2026-10-07T22:40:21-03:00 · Classification: Bug Fixes (explicit) · Systems: Movement, World & Visibility, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
fix(movement): depenetrate kinematic motor from initial wall overlaps
```

#### Original body

```text
Knockback could leave a character overlapping the wall tilemap. With
queriesStartInColliders enabled, every cast started inside the wall hit
at distance zero, so the motor blocked all movement and the character
stayed stuck.

Kinematic2DMovementMotor.Move now resolves initial overlaps against the
collision mask before sweeping, also when the requested displacement is
zero. The correction is excluded from the returned displacement so it
does not affect IsMoving or facing.

Add EditMode coverage for overlap recovery and the wall-stop regression,
and document the responsibility in PlayerMovementArchitecture.
```

### e8a04a41b58fab6d5a4bcf2965a2d67073d5540a

[e8a04a41b58fab6d5a4bcf2965a2d67073d5540a](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/e8a04a41b58fab6d5a4bcf2965a2d67073d5540a)

Date: 2026-10-07T22:17:50-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: Combat, Art & Animation, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(vfx): tint attack VFX by weapon damage type
```

#### Original body

```text
Tint the neutral attack VFX sprite by the confirmed weapon's damage
type, so elemental variants need no new sprites. This closes the
tinting criterion of TASK-173.

- AttackVfxTintPalette maps every DamageType to one color and
  validates that each type appears exactly once.
- PlayerAttackVfxPresenter requires a valid palette on enable, reads
  the damage type from the confirmed attack's weapon snapshot, sets
  the renderer color without allocations and resets it to white on
  clear. Tint stays local presentation; no networked state.
- Sprites-Default vertex color does the tint; no new material.
- Provisional colors: Physical and TrueDamage white (unchanged look),
  Magical soft violet (0.75, 0.6, 1).
- Wire the palette into NetworkPlayer.prefab.

Tests: add AttackVfxTintTests for palette validation, the project
asset, prefab wiring, Magical vs Physical tint and no tint leak.

Docs: document the tint palette contract in PlayerCombatArchitecture.md.
```

#### Original subject

```text
feat(vfx): add Spellbook with area melee and Cast Flash VFX
```

#### Original body

```text
Onboard the Spellbook as a playable one-handed weapon with an area
melee attack and the shared Cast Flash visual. This covers the
Spellbook slice of TASK-173.

- Stats from GD 09 section 6: INT 10, 34 damage, 1.1 s interval,
  2.5 tiles, 15 stamina, Magical. Loot id spell_book, since
  spellbook stays a legacy id.
- New SpellbookMeleeAttackConfig: radius 1.0, up to 4 targets,
  shared target mask. Radius and target count are provisional
  balance values; the shared melee config is unchanged.
- Hand-held rig, angle correction -90, grip (0, -0.15625), blade
  tip (0, 0.46875). Placeholder sword audio until spellbook audio.
- Cast Flash starts at 0.625 s on the 1.0 s baked clips at the
  strike hold; poses are unmirrored, sorting -9 back and 21 front.
- Bring Spellbook-Front/Back art and Spellbook_Attack source clip
  from ad87f4f3, without its Character.controller change.
- Generator: add the Spellbook menu entry; the one-handed bake keeps
  only the RightHand hierarchy.
- Register spell_book in the loot catalog, default container table
  (weight 10) and raid loot value catalog (100).

Tests: extend Cast Flash presentation, weapon catalog, attack
animation set, generator and animator view coverage; pin the area
melee config.

Docs: document the Spellbook alignment, area melee config and
generator note in PlayerCombatArchitecture.md.
```

```text
feat(vfx): add Light Crossbow with Bow Shot attack VFX
```

```text
Onboard the Light Crossbow as a playable two-handed ranged weapon and
wire it to the shared Bow Shot visual, following the bow pattern. This
covers the Light Crossbow slice of TASK-173.

- Stats from GD 09 section 6: DES 15, 50 damage, 1.6 s interval,
  8 tiles, 10 stamina, Physical. Reload is out of scope.
- Weapon-driven rig, grip (0, -0.125), release at 0.3 s on 0.5 s
  baked clips, no attack sprite animation.
- VFX starts at 0.275 s with a 0.025 s lead so the 0.2 s shot fits
  inside the clip; poses follow the authored 4.434 deg hand tilt,
  mirrored on NW/SW, sorting -9 back and 21 front.

  draw hold aims from its first main hand key.
- Register light_crossbow in the loot catalog, default container
  table (weight 8) and raid loot value catalog (100).

Tests: extend Bow Shot presentation, generator, attack animation set,
weapon catalog, ranged release and animator view coverage.

Docs: document the Light Crossbow alignment, rig and grip in
PlayerCombatArchitecture.md.
```

#### Original subject

```text
Synchronize ranged release timeline and payload
```

#### Original body

```text
Add deterministic ranged wind-up/release synchronization by introducing `AttackTiming` and a networked `RangedAttackRelease` snapshot that captures committed projectile data at acceptance and consumes it at the authoritative release tick. `PlayerCombatNetworkController` now advances/cancels pending releases independently of input, preserves cooldown behavior, supports migration-safe restore, and exposes release-aware attack events.

Update ranged presentation to follow the confirmed release timeline (animator + VFX), add per-weapon ranged release timing and VFX lead configuration, harden ranged/projectile validation paths, and expand edit/play mode tests plus architecture docs to cover release scheduling, cancellation, restore behavior, and calibration.
```

### a0f93a757fb59b95d53a9c41413493a41d523477

[a0f93a757fb59b95d53a9c41413493a41d523477](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/a0f93a757fb59b95d53a9c41413493a41d523477)

Date: 2026-10-05T22:38:45-03:00 · Classification: Other Changes (unknown) · Systems: Networking & Sessions, World & Visibility, Build & Tooling, Documentation, Tests

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
Implements changes from the PvE audit (US-49) to finalize the Dungeon pressure systems.  - Replaced obsolete EnemyCollapseDespawner and queue with explicit Collapse validation logic in DungeonPressureConfig. - Updated EnemyReinforcementDirector to generate reinforcements during Collapse, using ActiveAvatarObjects to ensure minimum spawn distances. - Added disableLoot support to NetworkSpawnManager, allowing Collapse reinforcements to spawn without loot tables to prevent exploitable rewards. - Set authoritative DefaultDungeonPressureConfig durations (15m Normal, 5m Early, 2m Critical) with a provisional 2m Collapse policy. - Updated DungeonPressureArchitecture.md to reflect the active components and runner-scoped lifecycle of the pressure controller.  Tests: - Updated DungeonPressureConfigTests to cover new validation rules.
```

#### Original body

```text
Implements changes from the PvE audit (US-49) to finalize the Dungeon pressure systems.

- Replaced obsolete EnemyCollapseDespawner and queue with explicit Collapse validation logic in DungeonPressureConfig.
- Updated EnemyReinforcementDirector to generate reinforcements during Collapse, using ActiveAvatarObjects to ensure minimum spawn distances.
- Added disableLoot support to NetworkSpawnManager, allowing Collapse reinforcements to spawn without loot tables to prevent exploitable rewards.
- Set authoritative DefaultDungeonPressureConfig durations (15m Normal, 5m Early, 2m Critical) with a provisional 2m Collapse policy.
- Updated DungeonPressureArchitecture.md to reflect the active components and runner-scoped lifecycle of the pressure controller.

Tests:
- Updated DungeonPressureConfigTests to cover new validation rules.
```

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
Add chest opening presentation before loot UI
```

#### Original body

```text
Implements a chest-only opening presentation flow by adding `ChestOpeningPresenter` and `ChestOpeningPresentationState`, wiring it into the LootContainer prefab, and introducing an `OpeningContainer` mode in `RaidInventoryPresenter`. The inventory screen now waits for confirmed chest opening playback when available, while safely falling back to immediate UI display when presentation is missing/disabled. Includes extensive EditMode/PlayMode coverage for ordering, cancellation, and non-replay behavior, plus architecture docs updates for the new UI/presentation contract.
```

### f22008e5dad9ee007fcd173332c2eb132ac40703

[f22008e5dad9ee007fcd173332c2eb132ac40703](https://github.com/Astro-Rift-Games/ProjectGrimhold/commit/f22008e5dad9ee007fcd173332c2eb132ac40703)

Date: 2026-10-01T23:12:03-03:00 · Classification: Features (explicit) · Systems: UI, World & Visibility

Flags: primary or unclassified

#### Original subject

```text
feat(dungeon-pressure): add local hud presentation for timer and phase
```

#### Original body

```text
Implemented `DungeonPressureHudPresenter` and `DungeonPressureHudView` to display the networked raid timer and current pressure phase on the local player's Canvas.

The presenter uses a resilient polling mechanism to dynamically bind to the dynamically spawned `DungeonPressureController`. It locally calculates remaining seconds using `Runner.DeltaTime` to update the text elements, keeping the UI fully decoupled from the networked simulation state.
```

```text
Introduces new placeholder lobby tileset textures and generated tile assets (limits and stone path), plus new prop materials for chest-open and stump sprites. Updates the Lobby prefab and Lobby-Town scene with expanded tile painting, prop placement, lighting/sorting tweaks, and adds a new "Floor" sorting layer in TagManager. Also renames the merchant prefab to TownMerchantNPC and updates related prefab metadata/usages.
```
